title: Listen and Choose a Response — Weekend Errand

questions.stem: Could I borrow your car to go to the hardware store?

options.A: My brother has it today, but you can take my bike.
options.B: The hardware store sells paint and tools.
options.D: I parked it near the gym last night.

questions.explanation: Offering an alternative because the car is unavailable is a natural indirect reply; the 'Yes' option switches the pronouns.
questions.speaker: m6
